question: What deserves a shared transformation identity, and how can parallel workers propose definitions without imposing global sequential scientific review?

local_contract.input: Source-bound connected operation selections, their actual material/data boundaries, evidence, and versioned definitions.
local_contract.target: Inspectable membership and definition-comparison decisions that support retrieval and comparison of protocol subgraphs.
local_contract.stable_structure: Record fields and edge meanings; the catalogue of transformation definitions may grow through review.
local_contract.identity: A definition ID identifies a scoped comparison concept, not an enzyme name, a universal protocol stage, or an interchangeable recipe.
preserve: Original protocol operations, ordering, interfaces and evidence
Whole-selection boundary, including additional downstream transformations
Purpose-level similarity separately from shared mechanism
Every proposal and the definition versions used in its review
not_identified: A uniquely correct or exhaustive biochemical taxonomy
Semantic duplicate absence from successful database transactions

references.name: EDC, EMNLP 2024
references.license: MIT; inspected, no code copied into the harness
references.observed: Definition embeddings retrieve candidates; an LLM chooses a relation or none. The released code canonicalizes relation names, bypasses verification for an existing exact relation key, and can enrich an in-memory schema during sequential processing.
references.adopt: Separate extraction, definition, candidate retrieval and semantic decision.
references.reject_for_our_task: Treating an exact string as scientific identity, immediately admitting a new definition after no retrieved match, or treating this implementation as a concurrent biochemical equivalence service.

references.name: Splink blocking
references.license: MIT; inspected, no code copied into the harness
references.observed: BlockingRule and block_using_rules_sqls generate candidate pairs from multiple rules and prevent repeated comparison pairs. This is candidate generation, not a semantic identity decision.
references.adapt: Union several overlapping routes to candidates, retaining route provenance and deduplicating pairs. Use full-definition semantic retrieval as an additional route and measure missed comparisons.
references.reject_for_our_task: Treating a matching blocking key as biochemical equivalence or importing demographic linkage scoring without validation.

references.name: Ontology for Biomedical Investigations
references.inspected: Results: Material entity, Planned Processes, Information entities, Roles and Functions
references.adapt: Separate process, specified inputs/outputs, materials, participant roles and objectives. Reuse external terminology only when its definition fits; do not infer a fixed list of stages for all assays.

references.name: OBO Relation Ontology module design
references.observed: Overlapping grouping/subset mechanisms and explicit discussion of difficulty choosing mutually exclusive domain partitions.
references.adapt: Overlapping retrieval collections over stable identities rather than separate scientific copies in exclusive domain buckets.

references.name: Intern-Atlas
references.observed: The paper reports a hand-curated method seed and author-adjudicated expansion. The inspected public local builder uses method-name overlap in a heuristic relation fallback, including after LLM failure.
references.adopt: Explicit identities and distinct relationship meanings.
references.reject_for_our_task: Treating the reported approach as autonomous discovery of experimental component equivalence, or admitting mechanistic/history edges from the local shared-term fallback.

references.name: Database concurrency specifications
references.observed: SQLite has one writer at a time. PostgreSQL offers row/advisory locks and serializable transaction checks. These enforce database predicates, not semantic identity of natural-language definitions.
references.adapt: Perform model work outside database locks. Commit with version and new-candidate rechecks. Existing-row checks alone do not cover newly inserted candidates.

current_code_findings: store.Registry.initialize stores the entire registry in one payload row.
store.check_proposal rejects stale new-definition proposals using a registry-wide revision; unchanged reuse is treated separately.
commit.commit_batch obtains BEGIN IMMEDIATE before full snapshot validation, batch checks and whole-payload rewrite.
Current deterministic duplicate checks cover IDs, normalized preferred labels and identical definition fields, not differently worded semantic duplicates.
Frozen matching stages extension requests but does not reconcile or promote them automatically.
The seven definition fields are natural-language criteria; a source quote and a structurally valid check do not prove entailment.

recommended_minimal_design.storage: Separate records for definitions and versions, protocol uses, proposals and comparison decisions; derived indexes over these records.
recommended_minimal_design.indexing: Search by several overlapping participant/transformation/output/information/purpose features, aliases and definition text. No single exclusive category or single hash controls scientific identity.
recommended_minimal_design.admission: A new definition needs an explicit useful comparison question, evidence-supported boundaries and a distinction that cannot adequately remain a property filter on an existing definition.
recommended_minimal_design.parallelism: Workers extract and submit immutable proposals concurrently. Candidate comparison jobs can run concurrently; likely duplicate pending proposals must be visible to retrieval.
recommended_minimal_design.decision_boundary: Only reviewed equivalent scope permits shared identity. Similarity edges and connected candidate groups do not authorize transitive merging.
recommended_minimal_design.publication: Start with one commit service and short transactions; keep all model reasoning outside them. Revalidate dependency versions and search newly accepted/pending records since the review watermark. A new candidate causes targeted review, not an LLM call inside the transaction. Recheck the watermark atomically at publication.
recommended_minimal_design.important_limit: Candidate retrieval can miss semantic duplicates. A commit guarantees the recorded checks were current, not that no equivalent definition exists anywhere.
recommended_minimal_design.scaling: Measure queue wait and transaction duration before adopting a row-locking backend or partitioned admission. Disjoint scientific buckets are not established by the current evidence.
recommended_minimal_design.source_safety: Keep source workflows unchanged when assignments or definition relations are revised. Do not force every operation into an admitted shared concept.

evaluation_to_run_before_scaleup: Simultaneous synonymous proposals: one reviewed identity with both source-bound uses.
Same enzyme but different transformation or endpoint: no false equivalence.
Broader/narrower scopes: preserve the distinction rather than turn one into an alias.
Related proposals found through different indexes: measure candidate recall against exhaustively reviewed small cohorts.
Unrelated additions during review: no unnecessary scientific rerun.
A new potentially equivalent proposal after candidate search: targeted reconciliation before publication.
Repeated submission or worker crash: idempotent storage and recoverable review tasks.
Ingestion order changes: compare scientific memberships and boundaries, not display labels.
Report candidate recall, false merges, unnecessary splits, unresolved cases, model review cost and commit wait separately.
work_done_this_turn: Primary-source and released-code audit, pinned public reference downloads, and this decision record. No production registry migration, concurrency implementation, graph change or live model experiment was performed.
